subject: could mirt accept sparse data matrix and/or data in long format?

messages.author: 65dfc0273afec556
messages.subject: could mirt accept sparse data matrix and/or data in long format?
parts:
I am dealing with a rather large data set (some millions of users, some tens of thousands of items). The data is sparse, so when user-actions are recorded in a long format, it is of manageable size. But to send this data to mirt() requires converting it to a dense matrix. For my data size it means running out of memory, so I am forced to sub-sample the data. I can't help wondering whether mirt() could skip the dense-matrix step and accept either data-frames in long format or (which is essentially the same) sparse matrices. Are there any plans to develop this?

Thank you,
Ilia

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: could mirt accept sparse data matrix and/or data in long format?
parts:
It's an interesting idea. I'm not opposed to doing this, though I wonder if making better use of packages like Matrix would help with the internals for highly sparse problems like these. I'll keep this idea active on the TODO list, though I won't be tending to this feature anytime soon.

Phil
